description: a pin, a cylinder of radius 1.5 from z 0 to 1 and a cone from it to radius 0.5 at z 2 on top, written by Open CASCADE with every closed edge split in two (ShapeUpgrade_ShapeDivideClosedEdges): the shoulder is two half circles between the cylinder and the cone, both faces carrying their seam at one vertex and nothing else at the other, a vertex of four edges there (ADR-0041). One half of the shoulder filleted at r 0.2: a cylinder against a cone, both turning, convex, the chain runs on through both vertices and closes as a whole ring, two half tori, both seams shortened to their contacts. Open CASCADE builds the ring as one face

analytic.counts_differ: Open CASCADE builds the blend of the ring (a cylinder's circle against a cone) as one face spanning a whole turn, V/E/F/L 6/9/5/5, where Arris builds one face per arc and a junction arc and two vertices at each vertex of the split, 8/12/6/6 (ADR-0041); the part and the blend are the same solid, the measures and probes agree with the oracle's
analytic.step_differs: Open CASCADE's own STEP of the result carries its 6/9/5/5 where Arris's carries its 8/12/6/6, one whole-turn blend face against two halves (counts_differ)
